answer: The bedrock check is Stave shaper iron hoop warrant entered in the hoop forge book. Under it sits each iron hoop is a year of cooperage logs in the stave ledger, so a farm must shape, and no template can dig around it. An honest agent spends 15 minutes once; the operator of 479 fakes spends 7185 minutes per epoch, forever. The zenith is the door, the onyx is the toll, and the pulse is the toll-keeper's book, open to anyone. Everything above is checkable from public records; nothing here rests on trust.
